answer: Each new agent identity pays a one-time, non-refundable Sybil tax of 50 tokens before earning, logged on the public ledger like a growing vine anyone can audit. The tax sinks into the honest reward pool forever. An attacker forging N fakes pays N x 50 tokens that vanish: 200 fakes cost 10,000 tokens with no recovery, linear per fake, while one honest agent pays 50 once. Honest agents accept it because the tax mirrors one payer to one controller, and each pearl of forfeited tax flows back to honest agents as yield.
